_note: What you see: Withdraw an application with an optional reason
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Aanvraag intrekken met optionele reden
Wij hebben nog stukken van u nodig. Stuu: We still need documents from you. Send them before 18 oktober and we will make a decision by 1 november.
Uw verzoek is binnen. Wij sturen u een o: Your request has arrived. We will send you a confirmation of receipt.
We make a decision on your request.
Het besluit en de openbare documenten wo: The decision and the public documents are published.
U belde over wanneer de nieuwe lampen ko: You called about when the new lights will come. We explained that the decision follows by 1 november.
U stuurde een extra foto van het stuk fi: You sent an extra photo of the cycle path near the bridge. We added it to your request.
Verzoek gemeld aan de balie: Request reported at the service desk
U meldde aan de balie in het stadskantoo: You reported at the service desk in the town hall that the cycle path is too dark in the evening. We pointed you to the request in My Zuiddrecht.
Wilt u deze aanvraag intrekken?: Do you want to withdraw this application?
Als u intrekt, stoppen wij met de behand: If you withdraw, we stop handling your application. You cannot undo this. You can still read the case afterwards.
This helps us. You may also leave it empty.
Intrekken kan tot de gemeente een beslui: You can withdraw until the municipality makes a decision, by 1 november 2026 at the latest.
